fact: UNDP says the Nzika registration application, which connects civil registration with national identity management, has been piloted in 87 locations across five districts, with expansion to 250 locations planned by 2028.
UNDP Malawi reports an NRB official briefed an EU delegation on the real-time birth registration system at Bwaila Hospital in Lilongwe.
The National Registration Bureau says over 970,400 child records from Phase One of its birth registration campaign had synchronised with the NRB Database by 6 February 2026.

UNDP handed over 152 printers (100 to NRB offices at Traditional Authority level, 52 to health facilities) to support digitalisation of birth, marriage and death registration, and minister Peter Mukhito said 180 health facilities have already been digitalised.
